title: Puttering Pebble Cuttlefish
statement: A thumb-sized cuttlefish with opalescent skin putters through a midnight-blue tank, where a single amber light pools over ivory sand and smooth turquoise pebbles. It patiently stacks the pebbles into improbable little doorways, flashes butter-yellow when one stays upright, then squeezes through sideways to investigate its own handiwork.
